selected_script.angle: Over-the-counter bathroom mess and daily clutter solved by hanging the 3-tier woven organizer on the door, showing quick setup and multi-room versatility.
selected_script.hook: Close-up of a cluttered bathroom counter where a hand tries to grab skincare but knocks over a shampoo bottle onto the floor.

usage_steps_used: Hang the metal hook over the top of a door or mount onto a wall stud/hook
Suspend the woven basket assembly by slipping the top rope loop onto the hook
Place items loosely inside the 3 woven basket tiers

segments.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life messy bathroom counter where a hand tries to grab a bottle but accidentally knocks a shampoo bottle onto the floor. 3-6s: Introduce the product as the solution: hand hangs the silver metal hook over the top edge of a white door and slides the top loop of the natural tan jute 3-tier woven basket onto it. 6-10s: Hand places shampoo bottles and towels loosely inside the three basket tiers. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the natural tan jute color, 3-tiered shape, or braided rope texture. Avoid any exaggerated pulling motions on the baskets. Handheld phone-shot style.
segments.negative_prompt: 3D render, cartoon, CGI, altered product shape, different color, wall mounting without hook, extra ornaments, slow pacing

segments.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2 showing a nursery door where a hand places diapers and baby toys loosely inside the natural tan 3-tiered woven baskets. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing a clean bathroom with the 3-tier organizer hanging vertically and holding toiletries securely without exceeding the 16 lbs limit. 8-10s: A light CTA text overlay reading: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.' Preserve identical product identity, natural jute texture, 3-tiered shape, silver metal hook, and vertical hanging logic from the first segment. Handheld phone-shot style.
segments.negative_prompt: 3D render, cartoon, altered basket proportions, wrong color, pulling down on baskets, hard sell
